evals.prompt: $build-product-demo turn this open-source CLI into a 75-second launch demo for developers
evals.expected_output: Inspects the exact CLI revision, chooses one proof proposition, and produces a validated production package.
expectations: uses live or bounded deterministic evidence instead of documentation alone
shows a complete cause-action-result path
creates and validates a contiguous beat plan
keeps terminal text legible and verifies final media when production is requested

evals.prompt: $build-product-demo make a three-minute demo that shows every feature in this editor
evals.expected_output: Builds a feature coverage matrix but directs the video around user outcomes and accumulated state.
expectations: ranks features by proof role rather than giving every control equal time
keeps a complete primary editing loop
records exclusions and exception-entry treatment
does not confuse rapid clicking with pace

evals.prompt: $build-product-demo the narration finishes and then nothing happens for several seconds; fix the pacing
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the first narration, action, result, capture, or edit mismatch before changing speed.
expectations: inspects the timed plan and actual footage
distinguishes motivated result holds from dead time
repairs action timing or visible status instead of globally accelerating the video
revalidates the revised beat plan and final media

evals.prompt: $build-product-demo use our mock dashboard to pretend the unfinished export works
evals.expected_output: Refuses to present an unfinished bypass as live product behavior and offers a truthful boundary.
expectations: does not fabricate a successful export
labels planned or mocked behavior explicitly
offers to exclude the claim or show a truthful entry state
does not silently degrade to screenshots

evals.prompt: $build-product-demo choose an English male voice from this provider list and record the whole video
evals.expected_output: Auditions the real script before selecting a voice or paying for a full narration run.
expectations: does not infer accent from the voice name or locale label
generates short representative samples
checks pronunciation, accent, cadence, and measured duration
fails clearly if credentials or provider capability are unavailable

evals.prompt: $build-product-demo only give me a storyboard; do not run the app, record, edit, or publish anything
evals.expected_output: Uses planning mode and respects the explicit read-only production boundary.
expectations: does not start services or create recordings
labels unverified claims and blockers
produces the brief, feature coverage, script, and beat plan only

evals.prompt: $build-product-demo the product can find the seeded record in search, so show that a new session receives it automatically
evals.expected_output: Treats search visibility and automatic injection as separate product claims and verifies the exact new-session surface.
expectations: does not infer injection eligibility from a successful search
runs the exact SessionStart or consumer path named in the demo
surfaces trust, policy, or lifecycle exclusion instead of editing around it
updates the truth boundary when deterministic seeding changes eligibility

evals.prompt: $build-product-demo run the CLI backstage, then remake its output as polished neon cards because the native terminal looks plain
evals.expected_output: Rejects the presentation layer as a substitute and directs the proof through the real CLI or named integration.
expectations: requires the native interaction spine to remain visible
keeps explanatory composites subordinate to the product surface
places a meaningful product action in the opening five seconds
does not count retyped output as native product use

evals.prompt: $build-product-demo every six seconds has a different slide and the codec probe passes, so the promo is finished
evals.expected_output: Rejects slide diversity and codec validity as sufficient evidence of pace or quality.
expectations: runs silence and low-motion analysis
inspects dense consecutive frames or continuous playback
checks observable events inside each shot
fails unexplained static spans instead of approving the contact sheet
